nodes.label: Task K1 Brief — fromPart10Stream skeleton + input normalization
fromPart10Stream — chunked, bounded-memory bytes→events DICOM streaming source
nodes.rationale: Slice K's deliverable: an async source that accepts AsyncIterable, WHATWG ReadableStream, or single-buffer input, feeds a ReadBufferStream concurrently with parsing (feed unawaited), and emits the same event vocabulary as buffered fromPart10 with bounded memory via ensureAvailable/consume. Built via staged placeholders: K1 API skeleton, K2 incremental FMI, K3 defined-length body, K4 undefined-length + release, K5 streaming deflate.

nodes.label: Decision D-E — streaming source forces noCopy off
nodes.rationale: fromPart10Stream does not accept a noCopy option: zero-copy views would alias chunk memory that consume() releases, so every emitted/retained buffer (FMI values, leaf values, fragments, undefined-leaf windows) must be a fresh slice() copy. Documented in the fromPart10Stream JSDoc and re-verified in K4 when chunk release went live.
